title: System.Text.Json rejects JSONC (comments/trailing commas) by default
symptoms: JsonNode.Parse/JsonDocument.Parse throws on a config file that looks valid
Existing user config silently overwritten with only new entries after a swallowed parse error
good_pattern: JsonNode.Parse(text, null, new JsonDocumentOptions { CommentHandling = JsonCommentHandling.Skip, AllowTrailingCommas = true })
error_signatures: '/' is an invalid start of a value
explanation: AI tool configs (claude_desktop_config.json, VS Code settings.json) are JSONC — comments and trailing commas — which System.Text.Json rejects by default. Parse with JsonDocumentOptions { CommentHandling = Skip, AllowTrailingCommas = true }. A swallowed parse failure followed by a write can destroy the user's existing config.
